# base stage
FROM acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/library/node:lts-alpine AS base

WORKDIR /app

ENV NODE_ENV=production
ENV NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS="/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"

COPY --from=acrprdfaurecia001.azurecr.io/cloud/azure/ca-certificates:latest \
  /ca-certificates.crt \
  /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

EXPOSE 3000

# build stage
FROM acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/library/node:lts AS build

ENV NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS="/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"

COPY --from=acrprdfaurecia001.azurecr.io/cloud/azure/ca-certificates:latest \
  /ca-certificates.crt \
  /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

WORKDIR /app

COPY . .

RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc,target=/root/.npmrc \
    npm ci \
    && npm run build

# runtime stage
FROM base AS runtime

COPY --from=build /app/dist dist/

COPY package.json package-lock.json ./

RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc,target=/root/.npmrc \
    npm install --omit=dev

USER node

CMD ["npm", "run", "start:prod"]

resources:
  repositories:
  - repository: mesx-ops-pipelines
    type: git
    name: MES_X.0/mesx-ops-pipelines

trigger:
  tags:
    include:
    - '*'
  branches:
    include:
    - main
    - ci/*
  paths:
    exclude:
    - README.md

variables:
  isMain: $[eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main')]
  caAppName: input-dis

stages:
- stage: Build
  jobs:
 
  - template: build/jobs/jobs-docker-build.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      folder: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)
      repository: mesx/input-binding
      npmauth: false

- stage: Dev
  condition: and(succeeded(), eq(variables.isMain, true))
  jobs:
  - template: deploy/jobs/jobs-container-apps-deploy.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      azureSubscription: spn-dev-inf-mes
      pipelineDeploymentEnvironment: app_cloud_dev_mes
      containerAppName: ca-gptmpxn01-eun-dev-input-di
      containerAppResourceGroupName: rg-gptmpxn01-dev-eun-mes-01
